title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct, named study environments in Albert S. Cook Library, with documented locations, formats, and access details.

cards.title: Settle into the Absolute Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2, Room 211
cards.notes: Bring reading or deep-focus work to Room 211, identified by Cook Library as an Absolute Quiet Room; keep conversation and calls elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A specifically designated quiet room on Cook Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library identifies the Absolute Quiet Room in Room 211 on the second floor as a quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Find Our Quiet Study Spaces! | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Cook Library, Floor 2, Room 211; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Use the Third-Floor Zoom and Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, back of Floor 3
cards.notes: Choose a pod at the back of Floor 3 for a contained work session; the library lists these separately among its quiet study spaces.
cards.short_summary: Named pods positioned at the back of Cook Library’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists Zoom and Study Pods at the back of the third floor among its quiet study spaces.
cards.source_title: Find Our Quiet Study Spaces! | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: At the back of Cook Library’s third floor; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Work from a Study Lounge Pod
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 3 Academic Commons
cards.notes: Use a private study pod for solo work or a glass table and display for collaboration; bring a valid TU ID for after-hours access.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 library lounge with individual pods, group tables, displays, outlets and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Lounge offers individual pods, glass tables, large displays, varied seating, outlets and printing; a valid TU ID is required after library closing.
cards.source_title: Study Lounge | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Available any time, day or week; valid TU ID is required after the library closes.

cards.title: Take a Fifth-Floor Perimeter Workstation
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 5
cards.notes: Head to the floor perimeter for a quiet-only workstation when your task needs sustained concentration rather than group discussion.
cards.short_summary: Quiet-only workstations arranged around the fifth-floor perimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists quiet-study-only workstations around the perimeter of its fifth floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Quiet study only; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Claim a Fifth-Floor Study Cubicle
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, back of Floor 5
cards.notes: Use one of the first-come, first-served cubicles at the back of Floor 5 for an individual session with a defined personal workspace.
cards.short_summary: First-come, first-served cubicles on Cook Library’s fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists first-come-first-served cubicles at the back of its fifth floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Read in the Fourth-Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, left side of Floor 4
cards.notes: Set up on the left side of Floor 4 for quiet study; the library also notes larger tables within the stacks and by the juvenile collection.
cards.short_summary: A library-designated quiet zone on the fourth floor near additional table seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library identifies the left side of the fourth floor as a Quiet Study Zone and lists quiet-preferred workstations and larger tables there.
cards.source_title: Find Our Quiet Study Spaces! | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the left side of Cook Library’s fourth floor; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a Session in the Graduate Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2, Room 211
cards.notes: Use the Graduate Reading Room for a library-based work block; its named second-floor location is listed alongside other Cook study spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named graduate reading room on Cook Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists a Graduate Reading Room among second-floor study spaces and identifies it as Room 211 in the building directory.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Second-floor study space; consult library hours and applicable room guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Focus in a Semi-Private Study Cubby
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Use a second-floor semi-private cubby when you want an individual setup without reserving a room; pair it with a library research task.
cards.short_summary: Individual semi-private cubbies listed among Cook Library’s second-floor study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists individual semi-private study cubbies on its second floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Second-floor space; consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Reserve a Second-Floor Study Room
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Reserve a second-floor study room when your work needs a closed setting; use the library’s room-reservation link to check availability and requirements.
cards.short_summary: Bookable study rooms on Cook Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library lists reservable study rooms on the second floor and provides a link to reserve a second-floor study room.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Room | Albert S. Cook Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; use Cook Library’s reservation link to confirm availability and eligibility.

cards.title: Build Your Project in the Data Studio
cards.subtitle: Cook Library, Floor 2
cards.notes: Choose the Data Studio for mapping, analysis or visualization work; it has individual and group stations dedicated to those project types.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor workspace with specialized stations for mapping, data analysis and visualization.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Library’s Data Studio has four individual workstations and one group station supporting mapping, data analysis and data visualization projects.
cards.source_title: Albert S. Cook Library | Towson University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located on Cook Library’s second floor; consult library hours before visiting.
